description: Gradient indigo button that responds while pressed down.
howItWorks: While pressed, background-color changes from #7A5FFF to #c1b4ff.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Evil Dodo 27</title>
<style>
/* Evil Dodo 27 by JkHuger — https://uiverse.io/JkHuger/evil-dodo-27 */
.click {
  margin: 2rem auto;
  display: flex;
  background-color: #7A5FFF;
  color: white;
  cursor: pointer;
  border: none;
  font-size: 1.2rem;
  padding: 10px 15px;
  border-radius: .25rem
}

.click {
  transition: background .8s ease-out;
  background: #7A5FFF radial-gradient(circle, transparent 1%, #7A5FFF 1%) center/15000%;
}

.click:active {
  background-color: #c1b4ff;
  background-size: 100%;
  transition: background 0s;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button class="click">Click me</button>

</body>
</html>
